about.title: Signal Hill Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Signal Hill is small — about 11,565 residents — and when a life is lost here, the absence is felt across the whole community. In 2025, public records show 165 injury collisions in the city, 254 people hurt, and 2 traffic deaths. Many of the city's reported crashes cluster along Cherry Avenue, Willow, Orange Avenue and Spring, and Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. carry the heaviest share. Not every fatal loss involves a car, of course; a fall at a worksite, a defective product, or a preventable medical error can lead to the same civil claim. California law lets a spouse or domestic partner and children bring that claim first, with certain dependents and heirs following. The window is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Signal Hill families with an independent attorney at no cost, so the paperwork and deadlines don't fall on you.

whyChoose.title: Why Signal Hill Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out quickly whether you qualify and how to proceed.

items.title: The two-year clock, watched closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the deadline is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early guidance keeps that window from closing quietly.

items.title: A civil claim, apart from any criminal case
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors file charges, your family's civil claim for funeral costs, lost financial support, and loss of love, companionship and guidance stands on its own. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our loved one was killed in a crash on Cherry Avenue in Signal Hill. Does the police report decide our case?
items.answer: No. The collision report is one piece of evidence, not the final word. An attorney can gather signal timing data, witness accounts, vehicle information, and other records from the corridor to build a fuller picture. That independent investigation is often what shapes a claim.

items.question: What losses can a Signal Hill family actually recover in a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial costs and the financial support your loved one would have provided. It also recognizes the loss of love, companionship, comfort, and guidance — the parts of a relationship that never show up on a receipt. No one can predict a specific result, but an attorney can explain how these categories apply to your family.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm, and what does it cost to use?
items.answer: LawProactive is not a law firm and does not give legal advice. We are a free connection service that matches you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters in Los Angeles County. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery.
